# Design Notes & Task Outline: Unioncorp

## Reference

- **Source**: ColorLib Unioncorp (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/unioncorp/`)
- **Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/unioncorp/`
- **Assigned Name**: `unioncorp` (Workspace: `@free-react-templates/unioncorp`)

## Structure Order

1. `Navbar.tsx`: Sticky top bar with contact details + primary navigation + CTA.
2. `Hero.tsx`: Immersive background banner with primary blue/navy overlay, bold financial advisory headlines, and action buttons.
3. `AboutStats.tsx`: Trust metrics, 40M+ stats intro, professional consultant highlights.
4. `Services.tsx`: Exclusive financial services grid (Financial Planning, Investments Management, Business Loan, Taxes Consulting).
5. `Gallery.tsx`: Case studies and portfolio showcase.
6. `Counter.tsx`: Technical statistics stats banner.
7. `Team.tsx`: Leadership team member profiles.
8. `Testimonials.tsx`: Customer feedback and testimonials.
9. `Blog.tsx`: Recent financial blog posts and updates.
10. `CtaBanner.tsx`: "Looking for business opportunity?" call-to-action banner.
11. `Footer.tsx`: Footer with links and mandatory Component Dock attribution (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Design Tokens & Styling

- Primary: `#4f86f9` (`bg-blue-500` / custom brand blue)
- Secondary: `#052c43` (`bg-slate-900` / deep navy)
- Accent: `#3bd381` (`bg-emerald-400` / success accent)
- Typography: Poppins font family across all elements.
